name: PT Asuransi Harta Aman Pratama Tbk
summary: PT Asuransi Harta Aman Pratama Tbk provides general insurance services and products in Indonesia. It operates through five segments: Property, Motor Vehicles, Marine Cargo, Engineering, and Miscellaneous. The company offers various insurance products, including property/industrial all risk, motor vehicle, freight, contractor machinery and equipment/heavy equipment, comprehensive machinery, travel, fire, earthquake, ship hull, legal liability insurance for delivery services, terrorism and sabotage, construction project, civil engineering work result risk, and advertising/neon sign insurance.
